item.text:
<linkedin_post>AI agents may be able to place orders for customers, but retailers still decide whether to let them access their sites. Amazon has blocked personal agents, while Walmart has welcomed them.

DoorDash is taking a route that combines outside access with its own tools. The company wants to work with third-party agent makers and has released a tool that enables other chatbots to place corporate orders. It has also launched its own chatbot and text-to-order service.

So far, DoorDash says it has received “several hundred” orders in total from third-party agents. Most customers still place orders through its app, according to CEO Tony Xu.</linkedin_post>
